name: hunt orcs, avoid strong packs
why: Keep hunting beatable monsters one at a time, but disengage early from gargoyle trios or bone knights and heal before going back.

hunt.says: Fight the nearest beatable monster such as orcs, finish it, loot valuables, and seek the next one. Do not take on packs that outweigh the warrior.

transitions.when: A pack is coming that is too strong for the warrior: two or more bone knights, or three gargoyles together, or anything much stronger than the warrior is approaching.
Health is getting low and falling, below about two thirds, and bandages are not keeping up.

regroup.says: Back away from the fight and let bandages or potions heal; fight only what is directly on the warrior.

transitions.when: Strong monsters such as bone knights or several gargoyles are coming at the warrior and health is not high.
Health is back above three quarters, or nothing is attacking any more.

out.says: Leave the area: run until nothing hostile is in sight, then recover health with bandages.

transitions.when: Nothing is close and nothing is chasing the warrior any more.
